lessons.title: The Photo We Can Share
lessons.goal: 從對話中辨識同意範圍與最後決定。
lessons.story:
Mia: I have a great photo of our class garden. Can I put it on the school website?
Owen: Does it show anyone’s face?
Mia: Yes. You and Sara are standing beside the flowers.
Owen: I am happy for you to share my picture, but please ask Sara too.
Mia: I asked her to join the photo yesterday. Isn’t that enough?
Owen: Joining a photo and putting it online are different choices.
Sara: Thanks for checking. I don’t want my face on a public website. Could you use the photo of the flowers alone?
Mia: Sure. I can choose that one instead and keep this picture in our private class folder.
Sara: That works for me. Please also leave our names out of the public post.
Mia: Okay. The post will describe the garden, not the students.

words.example: Ask before you share someone’s picture.
Anyone can read the public post.
The class uses a private folder.
We can use the flower photo instead.
The post will describe the garden.

questions.prompt: Where does Mia first want to put the photo?
options: On the school website.
Inside a science textbook.
On a bakery door.
In a garden shop window.
questions.explanation: 開頭 Mia 明確詢問能否放上學校網站。
questions.evidence: Can I put it on the school website?

questions.prompt: Which photo will the public post use?
options: The photo of Mia’s family.
The photo of the flowers alone.
The photo of the private folder.
The photo of Owen and Sara beside the flowers.
questions.explanation: Sara 提議只用花的照片，Mia 同意。
questions.evidence: Could you use the photo of the flowers alone?
reasons: 沒有 Mia 家人照片。
下一句 Mia 回覆同意選這張。
這張將留在班級私人資料夾。

questions.prompt: Why does Owen ask Mia to check with Sara?
options: Sara owns the school website.
Owen dislikes every garden photo.
Sara should decide how her own picture is used.
Mia has forgotten where the garden is.
questions.explanation: Owen 區分參與拍照和同意公開的選擇，不能替 Sara 決定。
questions.evidence: Joining a photo and putting it online are different choices.
reasons: 沒有說 Sara 擁有網站。
他同意分享自己的照片。
兩種選擇各自需要確認。

questions.prompt: What does “private” mean in “private class folder”?
options: Filled only with flowers.
Not open to everyone.
Removed from every computer.
Printed on thick paper.
questions.explanation: private 和前面的 public 相對，指限制存取的班級資料夾。
questions.evidence: I can choose that one instead and keep this picture in our private class folder.
reasons: 與 public 的公開範圍相對。
keep 表示保留，不是全部刪除。

questions.prompt: Which plan follows both of Sara’s requests for the public post?
options: Show both faces and all the names.
Show only flowers and omit the students’ names.
Show Sara’s face without her name.
Show only flowers and add Sara’s name.
questions.explanation: 需同時滿足不露臉與不列姓名，不能只滿足一項。
questions.evidence: Please also leave our names out of the public post.
reasons: 同時滿足前後兩項要求。

questions.prompt: What is the conversation mainly about?
options: Choosing a new name for a website.
Agreeing on a suitable way to share a photo.
Learning how to grow larger flowers.
Explaining how to delete a class folder.
questions.explanation: 對話從是否上傳談到照片與姓名的取捨，重點是共享方式的共識。
questions.evidence: The post will describe the garden, not the students.
reasons: 涵蓋不同意見及最後方案。
